name: CurrentMM.ar_moment_succ
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.arMoment decay v = v 0 + decay * CurrentMM.arMoment decay fun i => v i.succ

name: CurrentMM.ar_quadratic_succ
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay v =
    (v 0 ^ 2 + 2 * decay * v 0 * CurrentMM.arMoment decay fun i => v i.succ) +
      CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay fun i => v i.succ

name: CurrentMM.ar_reverse_factorization
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay v =
    (1 - decay ^ 2) * CurrentMM.reverseMomentEnergy n decay v + decay ^ 2 * CurrentMM.arMoment decay v ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.reverse_moment_energy_nonnegative
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ), 0 ≤ CurrentMM.reverseMomentEnergy n decay v

name: CurrentMM.ar_reverse_energy_bound
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ decay →
    CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤
      (1 + decay) ^ 2 * CurrentMM.reverseMomentEnergy n decay v - decay * (1 + decay) * CurrentMM.arMoment decay v ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.ar_quadratic_coercive
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ decay → decay ≤ 1 → (1 - decay) / (1 + decay) * CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤ CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay v

name: CurrentMM.decay_coercivity_monotone
type: ∀ (decay radius : ℝ), 0 ≤ decay → decay ≤ radius → (1 - radius) / (1 + radius) ≤ (1 - decay) / (1 + decay)

name: CurrentMM.mixture_execution_cost_identity
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ} (weights rates : ι → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost (CurrentMM.positiveMixtureKernel weights rates) v =
    (∑ l, weights l * CurrentMM.arQuadratic (rates l) v) / 2

name: CurrentMM.probe_energy_nonnegative
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ), 0 ≤ CurrentMM.probeEnergy v

name: CurrentMM.mixture_execution_cost_coercive
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ} (weights rates : ι → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (impact radius : ℝ),
  (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ weights l) →
    (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ rates l ∧ rates l ≤ radius) →
      radius < 1 →
        ∑ l, weights l = impact →
          impact * ((1 - radius) / (1 + radius)) / 2 * CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤
            CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost (CurrentMM.positiveMixtureKernel weights rates) v

name: CurrentMM.probe_energy_positive
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ), (v ≠ fun x => 0) → 0 < CurrentMM.probeEnergy v

name: CurrentMM.mixture_execution_cost_positive
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ} (weights rates : ι → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (impact radius : ℝ),
  (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ weights l) →
    (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ rates l ∧ rates l ≤ radius) →
      0 ≤ radius →
        radius < 1 →
          ∑ l, weights l = impact →
            0 < impact →
              (v ≠ fun x => 0) → 0 < CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost (CurrentMM.positiveMixtureKernel weights rates) v

name: CurrentMM.mixture_trader_solvency_energy
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ} (weights rates : ι → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (B P impact fee radius : ℝ),
  (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ weights l) →
    (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ rates l ∧ rates l ≤ radius) →
      0 ≤ radius →
        radius < 1 →
          ∑ l, weights l = impact →
            0 < impact →
              0 ≤ fee →
                0 ≤
                    CurrentMM.equity
                      (CurrentMM.traderCashAfter B P impact fee (CurrentMM.positiveMixtureKernel weights rates) v)
                      (∑ i, v i) P →
                  CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤ 2 * B / (impact * ((1 - radius) / (1 + radius)))

name: CurrentMM.dealer_marked_equity_identity
type:
∀ (cash inventory quantity price nextPrice spread fees funding : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.equity (CurrentMM.dealerCash cash quantity price spread fees funding)
        (CurrentMM.dealerInventory inventory quantity) nextPrice -
      CurrentMM.equity cash inventory price =
    spread * |quantity| + (inventory - quantity) * (nextPrice - price) - fees - funding

name: CurrentMM.counterparty_first_pulse_equity
type:
∀ (B P impact quantity cost : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.equity (B + quantity * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact quantity - cost * quantity) (-quantity)
      (CurrentMM.postMark P impact quantity) =
    B - impact * quantity ^ 2 / 2 - cost * quantity

name: CurrentMM.counterparty_first_pulse_margin_iff
type:
∀ (B P impact quantity cost margin : ℝ),
  0 ≤ quantity →
    (margin * |quantity| * CurrentMM.postMark P impact quantity ≤
        CurrentMM.equity (B + quantity * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact quantity - cost * quantity) (-quantity)
          (CurrentMM.postMark P impact quantity) ↔
      (margin + 1 / 2) * impact * quantity ^ 2 + (cost + margin * P) * quantity ≤ B)

name: CurrentMM.trader_first_pulse_equity
type:
∀ (B P impact quantity cost : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.equity (B - quantity * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact quantity - cost * quantity) quantity
      (CurrentMM.postMark P impact quantity) =
    B + impact * quantity ^ 2 / 2 - cost * quantity

name: CurrentMM.trader_fundamental_mark_equity
type:
∀ (B P impact quantity cost : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.equity (B - quantity * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact quantity - cost * quantity) quantity P =
    B - impact * quantity ^ 2 / 2 - cost * quantity

name: CurrentMM.two_account_equity_conservation
type:
∀ (Btrader Bdealer inventory quantity fill mark traderCost dealerCost : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.equity (Btrader - quantity * fill - traderCost) (inventory + quantity) mark +
      CurrentMM.equity (Bdealer + quantity * fill - dealerCost) (-inventory - quantity) mark =
    Btrader + Bdealer - traderCost - dealerCost

name: CurrentMM.funded_trader_pulse_equity
type:
∀ (impact cost margin P quantity h : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.equity
      (CurrentMM.pulseTraderCapital impact cost margin P quantity - quantity * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact quantity -
        cost * quantity)
      quantity (P + quantity * h) =
    margin * quantity * P + quantity ^ 2 * h

name: CurrentMM.funded_trader_pulse_margin
type:
∀ (impact cost margin P quantity h : ℝ),
  0 ≤ quantity →
    0 ≤ h →
      margin ≤ 1 →
        margin * |quantity| * (P + quantity * h) ≤
          CurrentMM.equity
            (CurrentMM.pulseTraderCapital impact cost margin P quantity -
                quantity * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact quantity -
              cost * quantity)
            quantity (P + quantity * h)

name: CurrentMM.robust_quantity_cap_pos
type: ∀ (alpha beta B : ℝ), 0 < alpha → 0 < beta → 0 < B → 0 < CurrentMM.robustQuantityCap alpha beta B

name: CurrentMM.robust_quantity_cap_quadratic
type:
∀ (alpha beta B : ℝ),
  0 < alpha →
    0 < beta →
      0 < B → alpha * CurrentMM.robustQuantityCap alpha beta B ^ 2 + beta * CurrentMM.robustQuantityCap alpha beta B = B

name: CurrentMM.robust_quantity_cap_iff
type:
∀ (alpha beta B V : ℝ),
  0 < alpha → 0 < beta → 0 < B → 0 ≤ V → (alpha * V ^ 2 + beta * V ≤ B ↔ V ≤ CurrentMM.robustQuantityCap alpha beta B)

name: CurrentMM.exact_equity_disclosure_separation
type:
∀ (B impact quantity cost h0 h1 q delta : ℝ),
  h1 - h0 = -impact ^ 2 * q * delta ^ 2 →
    B + impact * quantity ^ 2 / 2 - cost * quantity - quantity ^ 2 * h1 -
        (B + impact * quantity ^ 2 / 2 - cost * quantity - quantity ^ 2 * h0) =
      quantity ^ 2 * impact ^ 2 * q * delta ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.prediction_loss_derivative
type:
∀ (curvature observation theta : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt (CurrentMM.quadraticPredictionLoss curvature observation) (curvature * (theta - observation)) theta

name: CurrentMM.actual_quadratic_ogd_update
type:
∀ (theta observation gamma alpha curvature : ℝ),
  gamma + alpha * curvature ≠ 0 →
    (1 - gamma) * theta - alpha * deriv (CurrentMM.quadraticPredictionLoss curvature observation) theta =
      (1 - (gamma + alpha * curvature)) * theta +
        (gamma + alpha * curvature) * (alpha * curvature / (gamma + alpha * curvature)) * observation

name: CurrentMM.normalized_ogd_gain_unit_interval
type:
∀ (gamma alpha curvature : ℝ),
  0 < gamma →
    0 < alpha →
      0 < curvature →
        0 < alpha * curvature / (gamma + alpha * curvature) ∧ alpha * curvature / (gamma + alpha * curvature) < 1

name: CurrentMM.willingness_to_pay_integral
type:
∀ (V0 b cost L U : ℝ),
  ∫ (V : ℝ) in L..U, (V0 - V) / b - cost =
    CurrentMM.allocationSurplusPrimitive V0 b cost U - CurrentMM.allocationSurplusPrimitive V0 b cost L

name: CurrentMM.allocation_loss_from_actual_integral
type:
∀ (V0 b cost s0 delta : ℝ),
  b ≠ 0 →
    ∫ (V : ℝ) in V0 - b * (s0 + delta)..V0 - b * s0, (V0 - V) / b - cost = b * (s0 - cost) * delta + b * delta ^ 2 / 2

name: CurrentMM.capacity_interval_infeasible
type:
∀ (lower upper budget capitalPerQuantity depth : ℝ),
  0 < capitalPerQuantity →
    min upper (budget / capitalPerQuantity) < lower →
      lower ≤ depth → depth ≤ upper → capitalPerQuantity * depth ≤ budget → False

name: CurrentMM.clamped_capacity_feasible
type:
∀ (lower upper edge holding : ℝ),
  lower ≤ upper →
    lower ≤ CurrentMM.clampedCapacity lower upper edge holding ∧
      CurrentMM.clampedCapacity lower upper edge holding ≤ upper

name: CurrentMM.capacity_quadratic_difference
type:
∀ (edge holding optimum depth : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.capacityProfit edge holding optimum - CurrentMM.capacityProfit edge holding depth =
    (optimum - depth) * (edge - holding * (optimum + depth) / 2)

name: CurrentMM.clamped_capacity_maximizes
type:
∀ (lower upper edge holding depth : ℝ),
  0 < holding →
    lower ≤ upper →
      lower ≤ depth ∧ depth ≤ upper →
        CurrentMM.capacityProfit edge holding depth ≤
          CurrentMM.capacityProfit edge holding (CurrentMM.clampedCapacity lower upper edge holding)

name: CurrentMM.capacity_weakly_increases_with_budget
type:
∀ (lower upper edge holding b0 b1 m : ℝ),
  0 < m →
    b0 ≤ b1 →
      CurrentMM.clampedCapacity lower (min upper (b0 / m)) edge holding ≤
        CurrentMM.clampedCapacity lower (min upper (b1 / m)) edge holding

name: CurrentMM.one_cohort_jury_stability_iff
type:
∀ (kappa phi q eta : ℝ),
  0 < kappa →
    0 < phi →
      0 < eta →
        eta < 1 →
          have a := 1 - kappa * phi;
          have tr := a + (1 - eta) + eta * kappa * q;
          have det := a * (1 - eta);
          (1 - tr + det = kappa * eta * (phi - q) ∧
              1 + tr + det = 4 - 2 * eta - kappa * ((2 - eta) * phi - eta * q) ∧
                1 - det = eta + (1 - eta) * kappa * phi) ∧
            (0 < 1 - tr + det ∧ 0 < 1 + tr + det ∧ 0 < 1 - det ↔
              q < phi ∧ kappa * ((2 - eta) * phi - eta * q) < 4 - 2 * eta)

name: CurrentMM.causal_column_energy_bound
type:
∀ {T : ℕ} (impulse : ℕ → ℝ) (s : Fin T),
  ‖CurrentMM.causalImpulseColumn impulse s‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T impulse‖ ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.causal_column_norm_bound
type:
∀ {T : ℕ} (impulse : ℕ → ℝ) (s : Fin T),
  ‖CurrentMM.causalImpulseColumn impulse s‖ ≤ ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T impulse‖

name: CurrentMM.causal_first_column
type:
∀ {T : ℕ} (impulse : ℕ → ℝ) (hT : 0 < T),
  CurrentMM.causalImpulseColumn impulse ⟨0, hT⟩ = CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T impulse

name: CurrentMM.actual_convolution_quantity_bound
type:
∀ {T : ℕ} (impulse : ℕ → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ) (V : ℝ),
  ∑ t, |v t| ≤ V → ‖CurrentMM.causalImpulseConvolution impulse v‖ ≤ V * ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T impulse‖

name: CurrentMM.first_pulse_convolution_attains
type:
∀ {T : ℕ} (impulse : ℕ → ℝ),
  0 < T →
    ∀ (V : ℝ),
      0 ≤ V →
        have v := fun t => if ↑t = 0 then V else 0;
        ∑ t, |v t| = V ∧ ‖CurrentMM.causalImpulseConvolution impulse v‖ = V * ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T impulse‖

name: CurrentMM.exact_lifetime_quantity_signal_optimum
type:
∀ {T : ℕ} (impulse : ℕ → ℝ),
  0 < T →
    ∀ (V : ℝ),
      0 ≤ V →
        IsGreatest ((fun v => ‖CurrentMM.causalImpulseConvolution impulse v‖) '' {v | ∑ t, |v t| ≤ V})
          (V * ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T impulse‖)

name: CurrentMM.symmetric_first_tap_identical
type:
∀ (a impact q rate delta : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.splitPriceTap1 a impact q rate delta = CurrentMM.singlePriceTap1 a impact q rate

name: CurrentMM.symmetric_third_tap_difference
type:
∀ (a impact q rate delta : ℝ),
  CurrentMM.splitPriceTap2 a impact q rate delta - CurrentMM.singlePriceTap2 a impact q rate =
    -impact ^ 2 * q * delta ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.symmetric_third_tap_separates
type:
∀ (a impact q rate delta : ℝ),
  0 < impact →
    0 < q → delta ≠ 0 → CurrentMM.splitPriceTap2 a impact q rate delta ≠ CurrentMM.singlePriceTap2 a impact q rate

name: CurrentMM.split_transfer_difference
type:
∀ (q rate delta z : ℝ),
  z - 1 + rate ≠ 0 →
    z - 1 + rate - delta ≠ 0 →
      z - 1 + rate + delta ≠ 0 →
        CurrentMM.splitTransfer q rate delta z - CurrentMM.singleTransfer q rate z =
          -q * z * (z - 1) * delta ^ 2 / ((z - 1 + rate) * ((z - 1 + rate) ^ 2 - delta ^ 2))

name: CurrentMM.closed_price_transfer_difference
type:
∀ (a impact G0 G1 z : ℝ),
  z - a - impact * G0 ≠ 0 →
    z - a - impact * G1 ≠ 0 →
      CurrentMM.closedPriceTransfer a impact G1 z - CurrentMM.closedPriceTransfer a impact G0 z =
        CurrentMM.closedPriceTransfer a impact G1 z * CurrentMM.closedPriceTransfer a impact G0 z * (G1 - G0)

name: CurrentMM.ogd_rate_normalization
type:
∀ (theta x gamma alpha curvature : ℝ),
  theta - alpha * curvature * (theta - x) - gamma * theta =
    (1 - (gamma + alpha * curvature)) * theta + alpha * curvature * x

name: CurrentMM.ogd_normalized_recursion
type:
∀ (theta x gamma alpha curvature : ℝ),
  gamma + alpha * curvature ≠ 0 →
    theta - alpha * curvature * (theta - x) - gamma * theta =
      (1 - (gamma + alpha * curvature)) * theta +
        (gamma + alpha * curvature) * (alpha * curvature / (gamma + alpha * curvature)) * x

name: CurrentMM.actual_step_linear_coordinates
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact quantity : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (state : CurrentMM.CohortState n),
  CurrentMM.cohortCoordinates (CurrentMM.cohortStep a impact q rate quantity state) =
    (CurrentMM.cohortLinearTransition a impact q rate) (CurrentMM.cohortCoordinates state) +
      quantity • CurrentMM.cohortInputVector impact rate

name: CurrentMM.reset_linear_run_convolution
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : _root_.Module ℝ E] (A : Module.End ℝ E) (b : E) (v : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.controlledLinearRun A b v t = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, v s • (A ^ (t - 1 - s)) b

name: CurrentMM.actual_reset_run_linear_coordinates
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.cohortCoordinates (CurrentMM.controlledCohortRun a impact q rate v t) =
    CurrentMM.controlledLinearRun (CurrentMM.cohortLinearTransition a impact q rate)
      (CurrentMM.cohortInputVector impact rate) v t

name: CurrentMM.actual_reset_price_convolution
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ),
  (CurrentMM.controlledCohortRun a impact q rate v (t + 1)).price =
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (t + 1), v s * CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate (t - s)

name: CurrentMM.actual_cohort_record_is_causal_convolution
type:
∀ {n T : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q rate v =
    CurrentMM.causalImpulseConvolution (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate) v

name: CurrentMM.actual_cohort_record_quantity_bound
type:
∀ {n T : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ) (V : ℝ),
  ∑ s, |v s| ≤ V →
    ‖CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q rate v‖ ≤
      V * ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate)‖

name: CurrentMM.actual_pair_price_record_difference
type:
∀ {n m T : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q0 rate0 : Fin n → ℝ) (q1 rate1 : Fin m → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q1 rate1 v - CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q0 rate0 v =
    CurrentMM.causalImpulseConvolution
      (fun j => CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q1 rate1 j - CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q0 rate0 j) v

name: CurrentMM.actual_pair_observation_kl
type:
∀ {n m T : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q0 rate0 : Fin n → ℝ) (q1 rate1 : Fin m → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ) (variance : NNReal),
  variance ≠ 0 →
    InformationTheory.klDiv
        (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw T (fun t => (CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q0 rate0 v).ofLp t)
          variance)
        (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw T (fun t => (CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q1 rate1 v).ofLp t)
          variance) =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (‖CurrentMM.causalImpulseConvolution
                (fun j =>
                  CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q1 rate1 j - CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q0 rate0 j)
                v‖ ^
            2 /
          (2 * ↑variance))

name: CurrentMM.actual_pair_quantity_kl_bound
type:
∀ {n m T : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q0 rate0 : Fin n → ℝ) (q1 rate1 : Fin m → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ) (V : ℝ),
  0 ≤ V →
    ∑ i, |v i| ≤ V →
      ∀ (variance : NNReal),
        variance ≠ 0 →
          InformationTheory.klDiv
              (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw T (fun t => (CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q0 rate0 v).ofLp t)
                variance)
              (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw T (fun t => (CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q1 rate1 v).ofLp t)
                variance) ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal
              (V ^ 2 *
                  ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T fun j =>
                        CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q1 rate1 j -
                          CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q0 rate0 j‖ ^
                    2 /
                (2 * ↑variance))

name: CurrentMM.actual_pair_first_pulse_attains_kl
type:
∀ {n m T : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q0 rate0 : Fin n → ℝ) (q1 rate1 : Fin m → ℝ),
  0 < T →
    ∀ (V : ℝ),
      0 ≤ V →
        ∀ (variance : NNReal),
          variance ≠ 0 →
            have v := fun t => if ↑t = 0 then V else 0;
            InformationTheory.klDiv
                (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw T (fun t => (CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q0 rate0 v).ofLp t)
                  variance)
                (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw T (fun t => (CurrentMM.actualCohortPriceRecord a impact q1 rate1 v).ofLp t)
                  variance) =
              ENNReal.ofReal
                (V ^ 2 *
                    ‖CurrentMM.finiteImpulseVector T fun j =>
                          CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q1 rate1 j -
                            CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q0 rate0 j‖ ^
                      2 /
                  (2 * ↑variance))

name: CurrentMM.autonomous_coordinates_power
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (initial : CurrentMM.CohortState n) (t : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.cohortCoordinates (CurrentMM.autonomousState a impact q rate initial t) =
    (CurrentMM.cohortLinearTransition a impact q rate ^ t) (CurrentMM.cohortCoordinates initial)

name: CurrentMM.actual_impulse_matches_physical_pulse
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate t =
    (CurrentMM.autonomousState a impact q rate (CurrentMM.pulse1 a impact q rate 1) t).price

name: CurrentMM.actual_positive_impulse_peak
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ a →
    0 ≤ impact →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →
          a + impact * ∑ i, q i ≤ 1 →
            ∀ (t : ℕ),
              0 ≤ CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate t ∧
                CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate t ≤ impact

name: CurrentMM.complex_split_transfer_difference
type:
∀ (q rate delta z : ℂ),
  z - 1 + rate ≠ 0 →
    z - 1 + rate - delta ≠ 0 →
      z - 1 + rate + delta ≠ 0 →
        CurrentMM.complexSplitTransfer q rate delta z - CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer q rate z =
          -q * z * (z - 1) * delta ^ 2 / ((z - 1 + rate) * ((z - 1 + rate) ^ 2 - delta ^ 2))

name: CurrentMM.complex_price_transfer_difference
type:
∀ (a impact G0 G1 z : ℂ),
  z - a - impact * G0 ≠ 0 →
    z - a - impact * G1 ≠ 0 →
      CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer a impact G1 z - CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer a impact G0 z =
        CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer a impact G1 z * CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer a impact G0 z * (G1 - G0)

name: CurrentMM.unit_circle_rate_denominator_lower
type: ∀ (z : ℂ) (rate : ℝ), ‖z‖ = 1 → rate ≤ 1 → rate ≤ ‖z - 1 + ↑rate‖

name: CurrentMM.unit_circle_single_transfer_bound
type: ∀ (z : ℂ) (q rate : ℝ), ‖z‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ q → 0 < rate → rate ≤ 1 → ‖CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) z‖ ≤ q

name: CurrentMM.split_transfer_as_sum
type:
∀ (q rate delta : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
  CurrentMM.complexSplitTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) (↑delta) z =
    CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer (↑(q / 2)) (↑(rate - delta)) z +
      CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer (↑(q / 2)) (↑(rate + delta)) z

name: CurrentMM.unit_circle_split_transfer_bound
type:
∀ (z : ℂ) (q rate delta : ℝ),
  ‖z‖ = 1 →
    0 ≤ q →
      0 < rate - delta ∧ rate - delta ≤ 1 →
        0 < rate + delta ∧ rate + delta ≤ 1 → ‖CurrentMM.complexSplitTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) (↑delta) z‖ ≤ q

name: CurrentMM.positive_price_denominator_lower
type: ∀ (z G : ℂ) (a impact q : ℝ), ‖z‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ impact → ‖G‖ ≤ q → 1 - a - impact * q ≤ ‖z - ↑a - ↑impact * G‖

name: CurrentMM.positive_price_transfer_uniform_bound
type:
∀ (z G : ℂ) (a impact q : ℝ),
  ‖z‖ = 1 →
    0 ≤ a →
      0 ≤ impact →
        ‖G‖ ≤ q →
          a + impact * q < 1 → ‖CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer (↑a) (↑impact) G z‖ ≤ impact / (1 - a - impact * q)

name: CurrentMM.unit_circle_symmetric_transfer_difference_bound
type:
∀ (z : ℂ) (q rate delta eps : ℝ),
  ‖z‖ = 1 →

              ‖CurrentMM.complexSplitTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) (↑delta) z -

name: CurrentMM.symmetric_price_transfer_difference_uniform_bound

                          CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer (↑a) (↑impact) (CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) z)

name: CurrentMM.parseval_transfer_energy_bound

name: CurrentMM.counterparty_pulse_margin_all_times
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact A cost margin P B : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),

              0 ≤ margin →
                (margin + 1 / 2) * impact * A ^ 2 + (cost + margin * P) * A ≤ B →

                    have mark :=

name: CurrentMM.arbitrarily_small_solvent_exact_disclosure
type:
∀ (B P a impact cost q rate delta margin radius : ℝ),

                                    margin * |(-A)| * mark ≤

                                      margin * |(-A)| * mark ≤

                                          mark) ∧

name: CurrentMM.kernel_cost_entry_split

    ((if j < i then trades i * (kernel (↑i - ↑j) * trades j) else 0) +
        if i < j then trades j * (kernel (↑j - ↑i) * trades i) else 0) +

name: CurrentMM.quadratic_execution_cost_triangular

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_cara_exponential_integral
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (law : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (loss : Ω → ℝ) (mean : ℝ)
  (variance : NNReal) (gamma spread : ℝ),
  ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw loss (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean variance) law →
    ∫ (ω : Ω), Real.exp (-gamma * (spread - loss ω)) ∂law =
      Real.exp (-gamma * spread + mean * gamma + ↑variance * gamma ^ 2 / 2)

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_cara_certainty_equivalent

  gamma ≠ 0 →
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw loss (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean variance) law →

name: CurrentMM.exact_safe_radius_isGreatest
type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {m n : ℕ} (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (B : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.zero_output_no_radius_bound

name: CurrentMM.kreiss_neumann_hasSum

type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (M : ℝ), (∀ (t : ℕ), ‖J ^ t‖ ≤ M) → ∀ (z : ℂ), 1 < ‖z‖ → IsUnit (z • 1 - J)

name: CurrentMM.kreissConstant_le_powerBound
type:

name: CurrentMM.kreiss_values_bddAbove

name: CurrentMM.powerBound_pos
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ), 0 < n → BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ‖J ^ t‖) → 0 < CurrentMM.powerBound J

name: CurrentMM.outputGain_one_eq_powerBound
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ), CurrentMM.outputGain 1 J = CurrentMM.powerBound J

name: CurrentMM.kreiss_bilateral_radius
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (B : ℝ),
      0 < B →
        BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ‖J ^ t‖) →
          CurrentMM.powerBound J ≤ Real.exp 1 * ↑n * CurrentMM.kreissConstant J →
            0 < CurrentMM.kreissConstant J ∧
              B / (Real.exp 1 * ↑n * CurrentMM.kreissConstant J) ≤ B / CurrentMM.powerBound J ∧
                B / CurrentMM.powerBound J ≤ B / CurrentMM.kreissConstant J ∧
                  IsGreatest
                    {r |
                      0 ≤ r ∧
                        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)), ‖z‖ ≤ r → ∀ (t : ℕ), ‖CurrentMM.l2Apply (1 * J ^ t) z‖ ≤ B}

name: CurrentMM.tracking_prior_variance_pos
type: ∀ (Q R : ℝ), 0 < Q → 0 < R → 0 < CurrentMM.trackingPriorVariance Q R

name: CurrentMM.tracking_prior_variance_quadratic
type:
∀ (Q R : ℝ),
  0 < Q → 0 < R → CurrentMM.trackingPriorVariance Q R ^ 2 - Q * CurrentMM.trackingPriorVariance Q R - Q * R = 0

name: CurrentMM.tracking_prior_variance_unique_positive
type: ∀ (Q R P : ℝ), 0 < Q → 0 < R → 0 < P → P ^ 2 - Q * P - Q * R = 0 → P = CurrentMM.trackingPriorVariance Q R

name: CurrentMM.tracking_gain_unit_interval
type: ∀ (Q R : ℝ), 0 < Q → 0 < R → 0 < CurrentMM.trackingGain Q R ∧ CurrentMM.trackingGain Q R < 1

name: CurrentMM.tracking_prior_riccati_equation
type:
∀ (Q R : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.tracking_gain_explicit_root
type: ∀ (Q R : ℝ), 0 < Q → 0 < R → CurrentMM.trackingGain Q R = (-Q + √(Q ^ 2 + 4 * Q * R)) / (2 * R)

name: CurrentMM.ema_deviation_identity
type: ∀ (alpha oldAnchor price : ℝ), price - CurrentMM.emaUpdate alpha oldAnchor price = (1 - alpha) * (price - oldAnchor)

name: CurrentMM.ema_next_deviation_identity

name: CurrentMM.allocation_loss_formula

∀ (V0 b cost s0 delta : ℝ),
  b ≠ 0 →
    CurrentMM.allocationSurplusPrimitive V0 b cost (V0 - b * s0) -
        CurrentMM.allocationSurplusPrimitive V0 b cost (V0 - b * (s0 + delta)) =

name: CurrentMM.allocation_triangle_requires_efficient_baseline

    CurrentMM.allocationSurplusPrimitive V0 b cost (V0 - b * cost) -

name: CurrentMM.ces_price_impact_inverse_demand
type:
∀ (vHat lam p q : ℝ),
  0 < lam →
    have qStar := (vHat - p) / lam;
    vHat - lam * qStar = p ∧ vHat * q - lam * q ^ 2 / 2 - p * q ≤ vHat * qStar - lam * qStar ^ 2 / 2 - p * qStar

name: CurrentMM.cara_market_clearing_linear_impact
type:
∀ (m_t p_t kappa q_S q_t u_t : ℝ),
  0 < kappa →

    q_S * (p_t - m_t) - kappa * q_S ^ 2 / 2 ≤ q_S_star * (p_t - m_t) - kappa * q_S_star ^ 2 / 2 ∧
      (q_S_star = q_t + u_t ↔ p_t = m_t + kappa * (q_t + u_t))

name: CurrentMM.entry_mul_mono

name: CurrentMM.l2_opNorm_mono_of_entry

name: CurrentMM.output_norm_mono
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq κ]

name: CurrentMM.output_vector_mono
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [inst : Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq κ]

name: CurrentMM.peak_gain_mono
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq κ]

name: CurrentMM.exact_radius_contraction
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq κ]

type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (a η q : Fin d → ℝ) (K K' : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ),

type:
∀ {d : ℕ} {ο : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ο] [DecidableEq ο] (a η q : Fin d → ℝ)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {A A' : Matrix ι ι ℝ},

type:
∀ {T : ℕ} (B P impact flatFee commission funding margin V reserve : ℝ) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin T), 0 ≤ v i) →
    0 ≤ impact →
      0 ≤ P →
        0 ≤ flatFee →
          0 ≤ commission →
            0 ≤ margin →
              Antitone h →
                h 0 = impact →
                  CurrentMM.cumulativeQuantity v ≤ V →
                    funding ≤ reserve →
                      (margin + 1 / 2 + commission / 2) * impact * V ^ 2 + (flatFee + (margin + commission) * P) * V +
                            reserve ≤
                          B →
                        margin * |(-CurrentMM.cumulativeQuantity v)| * (P + CurrentMM.sequenceFinalDisplacement h v) ≤
                          CurrentMM.shortPerpetualEquity B P impact flatFee commission funding h v

name: CurrentMM.actual_physical_perpetual_fee_reserve_cap
type:
∀ {n T : ℕ} (a B P impact flatFee commission funding margin V reserve : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ),
  0 ≤ a →
    0 < impact →
      0 < P →
        0 ≤ flatFee →
          0 ≤ commission →
            0 < margin →
              0 < B - reserve →
                0 ≤ V →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →

                        (∀ (i : Fin T), 0 ≤ v i) →
                          CurrentMM.cumulativeQuantity v ≤ V →
                            funding ≤ reserve →
                              V ≤
                                  CurrentMM.robustQuantityCap ((margin + 1 / 2 + commission / 2) * impact)
                                    (flatFee + (margin + commission) * P) (B - reserve) →
                                margin * |(-CurrentMM.cumulativeQuantity v)| *
                                    (P +
                                      CurrentMM.sequenceFinalDisplacement
                                        (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate) v) ≤
                                  CurrentMM.shortPerpetualEquity B P impact flatFee commission funding
                                    (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate) v

    0 < impact →
      0 < P →
        0 ≤ fee →
          0 < margin →
            0 < B →
              0 ≤ V →
                (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →

name: CurrentMM.actual_physical_partial_fill_margin

                                        (CurrentMM.extendFiniteProbe (CurrentMM.partialLastFill v fraction))

                                  (CurrentMM.partialLastFill v fraction)

∀ {n T : ℕ} (a P impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.actual_physical_counterparty_equity_positive
type:
∀ {n T : ℕ} (a B P impact fee margin V : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin T → ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.positive_cohort_price_box
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact M : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (state : CurrentMM.CohortState n),
  0 ≤ a →

name: CurrentMM.actual_monetary_prefix_gate

  (v : ℕ → ℝ) (t N : ℕ) (reserve fee gain V : ℝ),
  t ≤ N →
    0 ≤ gain →
      0 ≤ fee →
        (∀ (j : Fin t), |C ((A ^ (t - 1 - ↑j)) H)| ≤ gain) →
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, |v j| ≤ V →
            |C (CurrentMM.carriedLinearRun A H z0 v t)| + reserve + fee * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, |v j| ≤
              |C ((A ^ t) z0)| + reserve + (gain + fee) * V
